verdict.rationale: The evidence pack shows Puzzle offers general real-time financial reports, dashboards, and metrics (ARR, burn, runway), but nothing documents dimensional tagging or the ability to filter/group reports by class, location, or tag—capabilities common in QuickBooks-style accounting tools that this axis expects. Missing for 10: any mention of class/location/tag dimensions, custom report builder UI, or grouping/filtering controls by these dimensions.
